name: Sierra Ops
source:
After nearly decimating all of mankind, humanity looked to the stars to rebuild its past glory. Under the guidance of a hero and his loyal followers, life was brought back from the brink, their legacy bringing forth peace that lasts to this day. But, trouble brews on the horizon...

Play as Captain Junius Fahrenheit, a soldier of the United Terran Vanguard, onboard the state-of-the-art ship, the Sierra, as they and their crew are thrown into humanity’s first interplanetary war. Tasked to protect Earth and free its colonies from under the Ares Confederacy of Mars’ grasp, there’s no question that they must fight to protect everything they care for...

...Are things really as simple as they seem...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/364210/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
人類幾乎被徹底毀滅後，為重建往日榮光，人類將目光投向群星。在一名英雄及其忠誠追隨者的帶領下，生命從毀滅邊緣復甦，他們留下的遺產帶來了持續至今的和平。但地平線彼端，麻煩正在醞釀……

你將扮演聯合地球先鋒隊士兵、朱尼厄斯．華氏上尉，登上最先進的Sierra號艦，與船員們一同捲入人類首次星際戰爭。你們受命保護地球、將殖民地從火星阿瑞斯聯邦的掌控下解放出來，為保護珍視的一切，戰鬥已不可避免……

……事情真的像看起來那麼簡單嗎？

［譯自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/364210/]Steam[/url]］
